# `fintech_txn_currency_supported`

> Only the ISO 4217 currencies the bank operates in are accepted.

| | |
|---|---|
| Domain | [fintech](README.md) |
| Layer | **silver** — evaluated by the `silver` gate |
| Model | `slv_fintech__transactions` (`fintech_silver.slv_fintech__transactions`) |
| Column | `currency` |
| Check | `accepted_values` |
| Severity | `error` — a violation **stops the pipeline** |
| Defined in | [dbt/models/fintech/silver/_silver.yml](../../../dbt/models/fintech/silver/_silver.yml) |

## What it checks

`currency` is one of: `USD`, `EUR`, `MXN`, `COP`, `BRL`.

## When it fails

The `silver` task of `medallion_fintech` fails, gold and `publish_gold` don't run, and the batch is never added to `fintech_gold`: consumers keep the batches published before. `quality_report` marks the run as blocked and sends the alert, if one is configured.

The rows that broke the rule in its latest evaluation are kept in `dq_audit.fintech_txn_currency_supported`.

## Tested by

Scenario **`invalid_currency`**: currency code that is not ISO 4217.

```bash
make generate DOMAIN=fintech SCENARIO=invalid_currency BATCH=2026-10-20_invalid_currency
make pipeline DOMAIN=fintech BATCH=2026-10-20_invalid_currency
```

## Investigate

```sql
-- rows that broke the rule last time it ran
select * from dq_audit.fintech_txn_currency_supported;

-- history of the rule
select batch_id, status, failures, recorded_at
from dq_audit.rule_results
where rule = 'fintech_txn_currency_supported'
order by recorded_at desc;
```
